name: [📈 2x + 📊 Trading] Anime Royale
desc:
Welcome to Anime Royale 👑 - the ultimate Anime Tower Defense experience you've been waiting for!

🔥 Dive into the world of Anime Royale and invite your favorite heroes to the battlefield! ⚔️ Strategically deploy powerful units and unleash their unique abilities to repel relentless waves of enemies! 🏆 Conquer challenging levels or show off your prowess in the various modes we offer for the ultimate test of your skills!

💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet and now on Console!👑
